capabilities: Draw on rendered Markdown and PDF files with pen, highlighter, and eraser
Separate stylus writing from finger scrolling, panning, zooming, and long-press text selection
Store annotations as overlays in a vault JSON file that follows file renames
Keep the native PDF text layer intact for selecting and copying text
Use stylus pressure and body-button or double-tap events when the system reports them
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not limited to OPPO devices; it works on Android tablets generally and on desktop, and is unaffiliated with OPPO.
extras: Not yet reviewed or published in the community plugin directory; manual installation is currently the documented path. The README states the plugin sends no data externally and makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in handwriting layer, so stylus users on Android tablets cannot ink over their notes or PDFs while keeping text selectable.

relations.evidence: The handwriting outline renderer uses perfect-freehand.

summary: Stylus-first handwriting annotation for Markdown and PDF files, with pen, highlighter, and eraser tools plus separate stylus and finger input handling.
